name: ActiveCampaign Webform
description: Adds a Webform handler that maps submitted fields to an ActiveCampaign contact and syncs it to ActiveCampaign on submission.
project_description: Submodule of the ActiveCampaign project. Provides a single Webform handler plugin ('activecampaign_contact', label 'Active Campaign') that forwards Webform submissions to ActiveCampaign as a contact using the parent module's activecampaign.api service. The handler configuration maps the required email field plus optional first/last name fields to ActiveCampaign, with an optional YAML mapping for additional ActiveCampaign fields / personalization tags. On submission it builds a contact-properties array and calls ActiveCampaignApi::syncContact() (ActiveCampaign contact/sync endpoint). Depends on activecampaign and webform.
